entries.question: I want my uncle death certificate
entries.answer:
I understand you are looking for a death certificate for your uncle. However, KGMU primarily deals with medical education, research, and patient care. Death certificates are typically issued by civil registration authorities, such as the Nagar Nigam or local municipal corporation, in the place where the death occurred.

I recommend contacting the relevant local civic body in your uncle's place of residence or where the death occurred. They will be able to guide you on the procedure for obtaining a death certificate.
